module: Flowgraph node 'Spring Smoother' (simple category). Should smooth a signal with a damped spring (upSpring/downSpring, upDamp/downDamp depending on direction; 'set' forces the state). Output 'value'.
notes: BUG: the node creates a sigmoid smoother (newTemporalSigmoidSmoothing) whereas getWithSpringDamp only exists on temporalSpring (newTemporalSpring in common/filters.lua): calling the node with a value raises an 'attempt to call a nil value' error.
The smoother is shared between instances (C.smoother).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Sets C.oldSet=0 and C.smoother (class) via newTemporalSigmoidSmoothing().

checkSetValue.desc: If 'set' changed, forces the smoother state.

work.desc: With no input, outputs the state; otherwise calls smoother:getWithSpringDamp(sample, dt, spring, damp).
